title: Even Blocks of At Most Two
body:
You are given an array A of n distinct positive integers. Count the rearrangements (permutations) of A in which every contiguous block made only of even numbers has length at most 2. In other words, no three even numbers may stand next to each other.

Return the count modulo 109 + 7.

Function to complete

Complete countArrangements(A). It returns the number of valid rearrangements modulo 109 + 7.

  • A: array of n distinct positive integers

Input reading and printing are handled for you, like on LeetCode. The input format below is what the tests and Custom input use.

JavaScript: products of two values below 109 + 7 overflow a double, so use BigInt for the modular arithmetic.
inp: The first line contains n. The second line contains the n elements of A.
out: The value your function returns (the driver prints it): one integer: the number of valid rearrangements modulo 10<sup>9</sup> + 7.

samples.ex: All three numbers are even, so every arrangement has an even run of length 3.
The odd number must sit inside the evens: E 1 E E or E E 1 E. Each pattern has 3! orders of the evens, so 2 × 6 = 12.

ref:
class Solution:
    def countArrangements(self, A: List[int]) -> int:
        MOD = 10**9 + 7
        n = len(A)
        e = sum(1 for x in A if x % 2 == 0); o = n - e
        g = o + 1                       # gaps around the odd numbers
        f = [1] * (n + 2)
        for i in range(1, n + 2): f[i] = f[i-1] * i % MOD
        inv = [1] * (n + 2)
        inv[n+1] = pow(f[n+1], MOD - 2, MOD)
        for i in range(n + 1, 0, -1): inv[i-1] = inv[i] * i % MOD
        C = lambda x, y: 0 if y < 0 or y > x else f[x] * inv[y] % MOD * inv[x-y] % MOD
        w = 0
        for t in range(e // 2 + 1):     # t gaps hold 2 evens, e - 2t gaps hold 1
            ones = e - 2 * t
            if t + ones <= g:
                w = (w + C(g, t) * C(g - t, ones)) % MOD
        return f[o] * f[e] % MOD * w % MOD
